title: Greenidge Generation Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Greenidge Generation Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on April 9, 2026, disclosing the issuance of a press release regarding an exchange offer for its outstanding 8.50% Senior Notes due 2026, which was originally commenced on March 11, 2026. The company is a Delaware corporation with Class A common stock and the senior notes trading on Nasdaq Global Select Market under symbols GREE and GREEL respectively.
